Baka Mitai (I've Been a Fool) (), originally titled Bakamitai, is a recurring karaoke song in the Like a Dragon series. It is first introduced in Yakuza 5 and is subsequently featured in Yakuza 0, Yakuza Kiwami, Yakuza: Like a Dragon, Like a Dragon: Ishin!, Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name, Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth, as well as Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties. It is sung by Kazuma Kiryu, Shun Akiyama, Taiga Saejima, Yu Nanba, Yoshitaka Mine and Akiko Wada. An acoustic remix of the song titled Bakamitai -sorrow- (, Baka Mitai -Aishū-) is featured in Yakuza Kiwami and is sung by Kiryu. Like a Dragon: Ishin! features a remix titled Baka Mitai - Ishin Spec Edition, sang by Saka

Battle Bonus Rewards are multipliers applied to the experience earned in battle. Most require a condition to be met, such as defeating an enemy with a specific attack, while others are increased with weapons, equipment, and upgrades. The mechanic returns in later installments, but instead of multiplying the money earned during random encounters, doing certaing tasks in battle increase the amount of experience gained per combat.

Bun-chan the Java Sparrow is a rotund and chunky bird collectible that can be found in the crane machine games throughout the series. She wears a hat with a brimmed chin-strap and tie. Bun-chan comes in two sizes (normal and jumbo) and a three different colors (pink, orange, and blue).

The song is composed and performed by the Japanese group, [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shōnan_no_Kaze Shōnan no Kaze]. It is the 3rd track on their Single "" (Entenka), released in June 6, 2012. It was later re-released as the 12th track on their album "", in March 6, 2013.
